questions.q: What shows the three men who visited Abraham had bodies?
choices: Their feet were washed, they rested and they did eat
questions.explain: They were angels of the Lord; some have entertained angels unawares.

questions.q: Why did the Lord say He knew Abraham?
choices: He would command his children and household to keep the way of the Lord
He was the richest man in Canaan
questions.explain: What makes a great husband and father is commanding the household in the way of the Lord, to do justice and judgment.

questions.q: What was the iniquity of Sodom, according to Ezekiel 16:49-50?
choices: Pride, fulness of bread, abundance of idleness, and abomination
questions.explain: She strengthened not the hand of the poor and needy, was haughty, and committed abomination.

questions.q: Why did Abraham plead for Sodom?
choices: The king of Sodom was his friend
He wanted the city for Isaac
questions.explain: He reasoned from fifty righteous down to ten, and the Lord said, I will not destroy it for ten's sake.

questions.q: How did Sarah receive strength to conceive past age?
choices: Through faith, judging Him faithful who had promised
Through a sacrifice at the altar
questions.explain: Is any thing too hard for the Lord? (Hebrews 11:11-12)
